shadingModels.Inherit: Preserve the supported legacy/direct Shading Models graph, its original model-specific inputs and instance model overrides. Only a direct Toon BSDF receives artistic ramps; do not silently convert inherited Subsurface to DefaultLit.
shadingModels.DefaultLit: Prebuilt Substrate Shading Models root with MSM_DefaultLit.
shadingModels.SubstrateToon: Native Substrate Toon BSDF and private/baked UToonProfile.

diffuse.zeroWidth: Canonical response 0 / 0.5 / 1; native float knots and LUT filtering give finite pixel transition.
diffuse.boundary: Restrict the original response to u in [0,1]; never clamp a full plateau onto an unreachable endpoint.
diffuse.rgb: Finite nonnegative linear response coefficients, multiplied by original BaseColor and lighting. Alpha ignored.

specular.zeroSoftness: Explicit hard-edge reference with half response at beta.
specular.limitations: Native NoV energy LUT, anisotropy, rect-light integration, outer NoL and visibility affect final result. Not a calibrated inverse for arbitrary lighting.
specular.backendFloatOverflow: Managed response RGB and peak must fit native FP16 (maximum 65504); reject at adapter boundary without changing canonical semantic hard domain.
specular.originalRoughness: Keep the source connection in NPR.Toon.OriginalRoughness.v1; restore it when artistic specular generation is disabled or DefaultLit is selected.

scope: Mesh component and material slot; every Section sharing a slot changes together, across LODs.
preview: Editor-owned transient material, MID/MIC and Profile; coalesce input at 30Hz; no synchronous GPU readback during normal interaction.
persistence: Unique UToonProfile + Material + MIC + NPRBackendStylePackage; never overwrite an existing source asset.
runtime: Apply preloaded immutable material package atomically; do not mutate ToonProfile.
advanced: Keep native Profile controls; disable artistic curve generation to author raw ramps.
verification: See ImplementationPlan.md; build is not rendering acceptance.
